title.zh: 1288 对 330：墨西拿的优势为什么不能只看人数？
title.en: 1,288 against 330: why headcount is not enough at Messina

editing_intent.duration_policy: Use actual speech duration. Every shot has synchronous narration; no independent silent reading holds or empty chapter-end cards. Chapter bridge at most 0.3s.
editing_intent.source_switch_policy: The opening contact, present knight footage, A01 reinforcement and A05 pursuit/terminal are separate recorded replay sources. Preserve short visible source labels and spoken source switches; do not imply a single captured causal chain.
editing_intent.numeric_policy: Highlight the actual UI field as the number is spoken. Internal records use a visibly distinct explanatory card, never a fabricated game tooltip.
editing_intent.chronology: contact; day-6 knight observation; day-11/12 reinforcement; later knight roster change; day-28/31 pursuit; day-32 A05 terminal and war state
editing_intent.narration_coverage: Continuous narration on real UI excerpts, source-labelled paused UI crops, and short narrated data insets. No dedicated silent reading holds.
editing_intent.source_continuity: Explicit spoken replay switches; every before/after pair remains within its own raw source. Separate opening contact is frontstory, not A05 continuation.
editing_intent.ui_caption_precision: Keep original UI units: the terminal war-score contribution is visibly-50%. Source labels and date context remain attached to every crop.

contact.claim: Original contact UI shows player 1288/enemy330; the original case later loses. This opening is not a new continuation of A05.

war_identity.claim: Player Robert is war attacker against primary opponent31549 Ali, associated title2111 Syracuse; encounter is Province2633 Messina. No unverified CB name or territorial promise.

knight_current7.claim: A visible knight row shows prowess7. No assertion that the new footage proves the historical11-to7 change or its full cause.

knight_mechanism.claim: Knight prowess and effectiveness are combat inputs; injury and death must be distinguished from total army headcount. Historical maim arithmetic is omitted from this film.

reinforcement_ui.claim: raw225 sea marker2570; raw350 left893/right1603; raw365 next date left827/right4106. These exact UI fields are not native regiment sums.

reinforcement_current.claim: Army22 has13 regiment records; starting2570, incoming current2560 because one regiment starts10/current0. Never add UI1603+map2570 as a predicted UI4106.

width.claim: Cached entry final width1480; recalculated returned final width2220; same-run first side0 damage call receives2220. These values were not shown in inspected game UI.

knight_roster_ui.claim: Visible knight counter changes11-to10 and a knight death report is visible nearby. Do not identify the old historical selector or claim a unique causal identity without the recorded mapping.

pursuit_ui.claim: Left Robert is battle defender and retreating, routed count824-to761; right battle attacker is pursuing. The semantics routed soldiers comes from vanilla verification, not visible wording in the currently mapped crop. Do not imply treatable wounds.

pursuit_ledger.claim: Three-day soft-to-hard conversion62.94269 people-equivalent.72 soft and69 readable hard changes match, under day28 input and losing-side screen0. Current_fighting fields themselves stay unchanged; UI integers are not equated to those fields.

terminal.claim: Day32 normal_result, enemy combat side0 wins; player army18 is retreating and out of combat. Robert is war attacker; player-relative battle row and same-run total war score are-50. Battle end does not prove war end or an active AI withdrawal order.
terminal.ui_limit: Mapped actual terminal war contribution is displayed as-50%; narrator says负五十战分. Do not substitute another run’s contact or fabricate battle-result UI.

limits.claim: No entire calibrated battle probability, future reinforcement ETA or proof that these independent knight/reinforcement observations caused A05 defeat.

chapters.title: 先问：人数优势能保持吗？

utterances.zh: 接战时，一千二百八十八对三百三十。近四倍的人数，真的够吗？
utterances.en: At contact: 1,288 against 330. Is almost four times the headcount really enough?

visual.focus: Start immediately on the real original PNG: left Robert 1288, right enemy330. Reveal the question during continuous narration.

utterances.zh: 罗贝尔与塞尔古塞领主阿里，在墨西拿接战。我们要看人数优势为什么没有保住。
utterances.en: Robert meets Ali, ruler of Syracuse, at Messina. We want to see why the numerical advantage did not last.

visual.focus: Retain Messina map and original player/opponent identities. Minimal three labels: Robert, Ali, Messina.

utterances.zh: 先看骑士名单和战斗属性，再看有没有新军入场；最后跟着败退和损失，看这场仗留下了什么结果。
utterances.en: First, read the knight list and combat attributes. Then watch for arriving armies. Finally, follow retreat and losses into the battle result.

visual.focus: Brief three-image montage: knight list, arriving army, war score. Narration continues; no silent holds.

utterances.zh: 这些是同一战例的几段独立复盘。切换时，屏幕会标明来源；每段前后变化，只在自己的回放里比较。
utterances.en: These are separate replays of the same battle case. The screen labels each source, and each before-and-after comparison stays within its own replay.

visual.focus: Simple source labels on actual footage. Do not display runtime IDs or long audit language.

chapters.title: 人数没讲出的骑士状态

utterances.zh: 先把军队总人数放到一边，打开第六日的骑士名单。总数能告诉我们有多少人，却说不清每个人还能怎样作战。
utterances.en: Set the army total aside and open the day-six knight list. A headcount tells us how many people are present, but not how each can fight.

visual.focus: Actual knight list with date context; highlight selected visible knight row.

utterances.zh: 这名骑士的勇武栏显示七。他仍在名单里，但七是人物的战斗属性，不是这支军队只有七个人。
utterances.en: This knight's prowess column shows seven. He remains on the list, but seven is a combat attribute, not the army's headcount.

visual.focus: Magnify actual prowess column and row membership together; label Prowess7 without adding historical11.

utterances.zh: 原版用骑士的勇武和骑士战斗力，形成伤害与坚韧属性。军队总人数，并不会直接告诉你这些差别。
utterances.en: Vanilla CK 3 uses prowess and knight effectiveness to form damage and toughness attributes. The army headcount does not reveal these differences.

visual.focus: Keep actual prowess7 row visible. Use UI term 骑士战斗力 / knight effectiveness. Explain attributes only, not daily kills.

utterances.zh: 这里要分开两个问题：他还在不在名单里，以及他的战斗属性怎样。名单上的人数和人物的能力，要一起看。
utterances.en: Keep two questions separate: is he still on the list, and what are his combat attributes? Read the roster and individual ability together.

visual.focus: Contrast actual row membership with prowess column; do not invent an injury before-and-after comparison.

utterances.zh: 所以，判断这支军队的实力，要同时看人数和当下属性。这一行的七，正是总人数里看不见的信息。
utterances.en: Judge this army through both its size and its present attributes. The seven in this row is information hidden by the overall headcount.

visual.focus: Pull back from knight row to army and map while narration continues.

utterances.zh: 不过，人物属性只是其中一层。接下来把镜头拉回地图：如果一支新的军队加入，整个接战局面都会变。
utterances.en: Character attributes are one part of the picture. Now return to the map: a new army joining can change the entire encounter.

visual.focus: Switch clearly to the separate reinforcement replay before its first number appears.

chapters.title: 地图上的新军，改变了局面

utterances.zh: 现在看增援这条回放。十二月十四日的战斗面板，罗贝尔这一侧是八百九十三，对面是一千六百零三。
utterances.en: Now watch the reinforcement replay. On December 14, the battle panel shows 893 on Robert's side and 1,603 on the other.

visual.focus: Actual bottom battle panel, left893/right1603, date context retained.

utterances.zh: 再看同一天海上的军队标记：二千五百七十。已经接战的敌军，并不是对方后续能投入的全部兵力。
utterances.en: Look at the sea marker earlier that same day: 2,570. The enemies already in combat are not the full force that may later arrive.

visual.focus: Magnify actual sea army marker2570 with original map/date. Present as earlier same-day look, not a later-time continuation.

utterances.zh: 到了十二月十五日，同一回放里的面板变成了：罗贝尔八百二十七，敌方四千一百零六。
utterances.en: On December 15, the panel in that same replay changes to 827 for Robert and 4,106 for the enemy.

visual.focus: Actual827/4106 panel; align and highlight the same fields as the prior frame.

utterances.zh: 把同一回放的前后面板放在一起，局势变化就清楚了。眼前要面对的兵力，已远多于最初接战时看到的数量。
utterances.en: The panels from the same replay make the change clear. The force now faced is far larger than the number seen at initial contact.

visual.focus: Side-by-side A01 same-field comparison893/1603 to827/4106. Original contact330 only as explicitly labelled earlier context.

utterances.zh: 海上标记和战斗面板，是不同位置、不同时点的读数。前后人数变化，也不能直接当作新军的入场人数。
utterances.en: The sea marker and battle panel are readings from different places and times. The change between panels is not itself the newcomer’s strength.

visual.focus: Highlight the two real UI fields separately; never show a false arithmetic equality.

utterances.zh: 同次原生跟踪，还记录了新军的十三条兵团：起始人数合计二千五百七十，当前加入人数是二千五百六十。
utterances.en: The same native trace records thirteen incoming regiments: 2,570 starting troops, but 2,560 current troops joining.

visual.focus: Short narrated card labelled same-replay recorded regiment values: starting2570/current2560. Keep actual arrival map beside it.

utterances.zh: 另十人对应的那条兵团，当前人数为零。这说明起始数和当前数有区别；这里没有证明十人是怎样减少的。
utterances.en: The regiment accounting for the other ten has zero current troops. Starting and current strength differ; this does not show how those ten were lost.

visual.focus: Reveal the one starting10/current0 row; no large raw fixed-point numbers.

utterances.zh: 这次新军加入后，原版也重算了战宽。战宽会限制全侧发挥出的伤害，人数增长与伤害增长，并不是简单等号。
utterances.en: After this join, vanilla recalculates combat width. Width limits the side’s damage output, so more troops do not translate directly into proportionally more damage.

visual.focus: Actual battle view remains beside a clearly separate combat-width explanation. Do not fake a width UI field.

utterances.zh: 这次记录中，加入前的最终战宽是一千四百八十，重算后是二千二百二十；下一次出伤，也实际用了新值。
utterances.en: Here, final combat width is 1,480 before the join and 2,220 after recalculation. The next damage calculation actually receives the new value.

visual.focus: A01 recorded width1480 to2220 and next damage input2220. Speak through the reveal; no silent reading hold.

utterances.zh: 所以要重新判断局面，不能只把地图上多出来的数字加一下；参战名单和后续计算，都已经跟着新军改变。
utterances.en: Reassessing the position takes more than adding a number on the map. The participant list and subsequent calculation change with the new army.

visual.focus: Return to the actual827/4106 panel, with a small arrival-to-new-panel connection.

utterances.zh: 这段让我们看见已经发生的加入，却还没有提前算出所有未来增援的到达日。知道现在变了，与预知下一次何时变，是两件事。
utterances.en: This shows a join that has happened. It does not predict every future reinforcement date. Seeing a change and forecasting the next one are different tasks.

visual.focus: Actual army and battle remain visible; no empty limitations card or technical audit text.

chapters.title: 接战后半段：少了谁，又损失了什么？

utterances.zh: 战斗到了后半段，再看两个问题：名单里少了谁，败退还会带走多少损失？先看另一条骑士回放。
utterances.en: In the later battle, ask who has left the list and what further losses defeat brings. First, watch a separate knight replay.

visual.focus: Explicitly switch to the later knight replay; display actual date and knight panel.

utterances.zh: 这段连续画面里，我方骑士数从十一变成十；随后战报出现一条阵亡记录。先把这两处真实变化看清楚。
utterances.en: In this continuous footage, our knight count changes from eleven to ten. A death report then appears. Read these two visible changes first.

visual.focus: Show exact same-source11/10 counter crops and subsequent actual death report; no historic selector or RNG attribution.

utterances.zh: 名单少了一位，意味着不能再用旧名单判断这一侧。我们跟着这段录像读战报，接下来再看败退中的整体损失。
utterances.en: With one fewer knight, the old roster no longer describes this side. Follow this recording’s report, then turn to the wider losses during retreat.

visual.focus: Keep the recorded list/report visible. Do not show old020/070/036 arithmetic as if it belongs to this footage.

utterances.zh: 接下来切到追击回放。第二十八日，左侧罗贝尔已经是撤退的一方，右侧敌军正在追击。
utterances.en: Now switch to the pursuit replay. On day 28, Robert on the left is retreating, while the enemy on the right is pursuing.

visual.focus: Actual left defender/retreating and right attacker/pursuing labels with date. No seamless join from the knight source.

utterances.zh: 这部分兵员，按原版语义属于溃散。左侧数字，从八百二十四变成七百六十一；追击还在继续。
utterances.en: Under the verified vanilla meaning, these are routed soldiers. The left-side count goes from 824 to 761 while pursuit continues.

visual.focus: Highlight actual same-source824-to761 counters, retreating and pursuing labels. Routed soldiers is a verified explanation, not wording visible in this crop; do not invent a tooltip or label the term as visible original UI.

utterances.zh: 主阶段结束，损失也没有立刻停下。追击期间，原版还会继续结算败方已有的溃散和伤亡。
utterances.en: Losses do not stop the moment the main phase ends. During pursuit, the game continues resolving the losing side's routed force and casualties.

visual.focus: Retain pursuit phase labels and changed routed count; show no generic blank panel.

utterances.zh: 核对同次回放这三次跨日的账本，约六十三人当量，从软损失转成永久损失。它解释的是追击中的损失变化。
utterances.en: Across three daily ticks in the same replay, about 63 people-equivalent move from soft loss to permanent loss. This describes the losses during pursuit.

visual.focus: Keep pursuit UI visible beside a short narrated, explicitly labelled 原生记录 / native record inset: three ticks, total62.94269≈63 people-equivalent soft-to-permanent loss. No silent hold.

utterances.zh: 面板是取整人数，账本还有自己的精度和定义。我们把它们并排看，保留各自口径；约六十三，也保留约字。
utterances.en: The panel uses whole-number counts; the ledger has its own precision and definitions. Read them side by side, and keep about 63 explicitly approximate.

visual.focus: Real UI824/761 left, labelled recorded loss≈63 right. Preserve the distinction visibly and briefly.

utterances.zh: 这条回放里，给定第二十八日的状态，我们把三天逐团损失算到了与原版一致。它回答的是这段追击，不是战前整场胜率。
utterances.en: Given this replay's day 28 state, our three-day regiment loss calculation agrees with vanilla. It answers this pursuit segment, not the pre-battle win probability.

visual.focus: Small three-day agreement mark; keep real battle view visible. No large test counts or audit jargon.

utterances.zh: 到这里，问题已经从能不能保持优势，变成败退还会带走多少损失。最后，我们要看原版怎样结束这场战斗。
utterances.en: The question has moved from preserving an advantage to the cost of defeat. Finally, watch how the game ends this battle.

visual.focus: Continue within the A05 pursuit/terminal source; use actual result-related footage.

chapters.title: 败退怎样进入战争结果？

utterances.zh: 第三十二日，追击这条回放的结果已经确定：敌军获胜，罗贝尔的军队脱离战斗，处在败退状态。
utterances.en: On day 32, the pursuit replay has a confirmed result: the enemy wins, and Robert's army leaves the battle in retreat.

visual.focus: Actual A05 result/retreat UI tied to same-run native result. Avoid a fabricated battle-result window.

utterances.zh: 这里有一处容易看反：罗贝尔在这场遭遇战里是防御方，在整场战争里却是进攻方。两张面板说的是两种身份。
utterances.en: One distinction is easy to reverse: Robert defends in this encounter, but attacks in the war. The two panels describe different roles.

visual.focus: Highlight actual battle defender Robert and war attacker Robert, with the same person's identity retained.

utterances.zh: 所以要看罗贝尔这一侧的战争面板。它显示负五十战分；这场败仗，已经让他在战争账上吃了亏。
utterances.en: Read the war panel from Robert's side. It shows minus 50 war score: this defeat has cost him in the war ledger.

visual.focus: Magnify the actual player-relative war-score-50 field with war/player context.

utterances.zh: 这条后段回放的败退，已经记下负五十；战争仍在继续。
utterances.en: This later-stage replay records retreat and minus 50; the war continues.

visual.focus: Keep actual player-relative-50 panel and army context. Do not display numerator/denominator/CB arithmetic.

utterances.zh: 这场战斗结束，战争仍在继续。这里看到的是正常结算后的败退，没有证明罗贝尔在交战途中主动下令撤退。
utterances.en: This battle has ended, but the war continues. The retreat follows the normal result; it does not show Robert voluntarily ordering a mid-battle withdrawal.

visual.focus: Keep active war panel and recorded retreat context; avoid an invented peace/declaration outcome.

utterances.zh: 回头看，最初的人数只回答了接战那一刻。骑士状态、已经到场的新军、追击中的损失，都需要在各自时点重新看清。
utterances.en: The opening count answers only the moment of contact. Knight condition, armies that have arrived, and pursuit losses must be read at their own times.

visual.focus: Brief real UI recap in chronological order; preserve each independent source label.

utterances.zh: 这几段让我们知道该观察什么，也核对了局部计算；仍没有证明，骑士或增援中的某一步就是另一条回放败北的唯一原因。
utterances.en: These segments show what to observe and check local calculations. They do not prove that one knight or reinforcement change alone caused another replay's defeat.

visual.focus: Show source-separated real before/after panels; no long unspoken limitations card.

utterances.zh: 本期确定的结果，是这条后段回放败退、战分负五十。下一步要回答的，是换掉这些条件后，接战前的判断还能不能经得住整场战斗。
utterances.en: The confirmed result is retreat and minus 50 in this later-stage replay. Next, we must test whether a pre-contact judgment survives a full battle under changed conditions.

visual.focus: End on actual Robert war-score/army context, with one short next-question line. End within0.3s of narration.

review_scope: Source text/facts/UI narrative review only. Not complete video review, clean-span certification, or human signoff.

opening_timing_target.gate: Producer must measure real TTS durations; shorten pauses or re-record in a new attempt if unmet.

supersedes.reason: Remove t04 at-contact advantage wording from A05 terminal; the1288:330 contact belongs to original frontstory.
